mcqs.question: The Swarna Naravaripalli solarisation project is expected to reduce carbon-dioxide emissions by how much annually?
mcqs.explanation: The project is expected to reduce emissions by 4,188 metric tonnes of CO2 a year. The figure 3,396 refers to the project’s capacity in kW, while 4.89 million is the annual power generation figure.

mcqs.question: The Swarna Naravaripalli solarisation project is linked with which of the following national targets?
options: The National Solar Mission and India’s Net-Zero 2070 target
The PM Surya Ghar Scheme and PM-KUSUM target
The National Solar Mission and India’s Net-Zero 2030 target
The PM Surya Ghar Scheme and India’s Net-Zero 2070 target
mcqs.explanation: The project is linked to the National Solar Mission and India’s Net-Zero 2070 target. The other options incorrectly substitute scheme names or change the net-zero target year.
